title: ChatHEA assistant guides high-entropy alloy catalysts for fuel cells
summary: ChatHEA, a domain-specific LLM assistant for high-entropy alloy electrocatalysis, guided synthesis and screening of 100 five-element alloy catalysts. The FeCoCuPtIr catalyst reached a peak power density of 0.789 W cm-2 in a fuel cell and outperformed commercial Pt/C in electrochemical tests. Evidence caveat: the press release gives no numeric activity values or the numeric DOE target it cites as exceeded, and the paper was not accessed.
organization: Tohoku University, Advanced Institute for Materials Research (AIMR)
